title: Relay developer platform launch page
audience: Backend engineers evaluating an event-delivery API
scenario: Relay provides durable webhooks with retries, observability, signing, and local replay tools.
task: Build a technical product page that lets an engineer understand the API quickly and begin integrating without marketing-heavy friction.

sections: Compact navigation with Docs, SDKs, Status, Pricing, Sign in, and Start building
Hero with reliability promise, Start building, Read the docs, and a local code example
Capability overview for retries, signing, replay, and delivery logs
Integration path showing Create endpoint, Send event, and Inspect delivery
SDK list for TypeScript, Python, Go, Ruby, and Java
Reliability note covering idempotency keys and exponential backoff
Developer-focused final call to action and footer

requirements: Render the example as a code block with a language label and readable plain-text fallback
Keep documentation access prominent alongside the signup action
Use ordered steps for the integration path
Use links or buttons according to whether an action navigates or performs an action
Account for long code lines and narrow screens without page-level horizontal overflow
constraints: Do not load syntax-highlighting libraries or external packages at runtime
Do not invent uptime percentages, customer logos, or benchmark numbers
Do not require JavaScript for core content visibility
Use only the supplied SDK languages
evaluation_focus: Fast technical comprehension with restrained product messaging
Semantic, overflow-safe presentation of code and ordered setup steps
Appropriate density for an engineering audience
